title: IUCN Red List
definition: The IUCN Red List of Threatened Species is the world's most comprehensive inventory of the global conservation status of biological species, utilizing a set of quantitative criteria to evaluate the extinction risk of thousands of species and subspecies.
importanceInUpsc: It is a perennial favorite in Environment & Ecology. Questions focus on the criteria for classification, the distinction between 'Extinct in the Wild' vs 'Extinct', and the role of IUCN in global biodiversity governance (e.g., CITES, CBD).
learningOutcomes: Master foundational concepts and mechanisms of IUCN Red List.
Evaluate spatial distribution, institutional frameworks, and policy dimensions.
Apply high-yield mnemonics to solve tricky Prelims and Mains questions.
prerequisites: Basic understanding of Biodiversity and Ecosystems
